messages:
maria: Heads-up — nightly-evals flagged an unexpected drop for promptpack v37 on the fewshot_intent pset. ~8.4% absolute F1 down vs our baseline (last green). @kevin @sam :eyes:

eval-bot: nightly-eval summary:
```
model: rwinf-2.1
baseline_commit: a1b2c3d
new_commit: d4e5f6g
pset: fewshot_intent
metric: F1
baseline: 0.893
new: 0.809
delta: -0.084 (-9.4%)
alert: regression_threshold_exceeded
```

maria: I ran a quick git blame on the promptpack build — there was a tiny change to the prompt builder last week that strips trailing punctuation from examples (`strip_trailing_punct=True`). I think that altered prefix formatting for several few-shot examples. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/promptpacks/commits/d4e5f6g

kevin: ah ok — that sounds plausible. Do we have a minimal diff of the prompts before/after?

maria: pasted a tiny diff below (only showing one example):
```
-Example: "Book a flight to SFO."
+Example: "Book a flight to SFO"
```
It removed the final period inside the shot examples; model appears to change punctuation-driven completions.

alice: Hmm — two options: 1) revert the `strip_trailing_punct` for promptpack v37 and re-run nightly, or 2) rebaseline pset (accept new behavior) if we think punctuation-insensitive is intended. Which is safer short-term?

sam: leaning revert-for-canary. This will isolate whether the behavior change alone caused the F1 drop. Rebaseline would hide the regression and mask other issues.

kevin: +1 revert. We should also run a targeted canary against the affected pset on a small host pool before full rollout.

devon: Agreed with revert. Can we get QA to eyeball a handful of failure cases before merging? @qa-bot can you assemble 10 random fails and post them here? :mag:

qa-bot: grabbed failures (10 samples) — showing model output vs expected for the pset (shortlist):
```
case 001: input: "I need a ticket to SFO" expected: "Book flight to SFO" got: "Booking flight to SFO?"
case 004: input: "Reserve a spot at dojo" expected: "Reserve spot" got: "Reserve spot."
case 007: input: "Schedule meeting at 3pm" expected: "Schedule meeting at 3pm" got: "Schedule meeting at 3pm?"
... (samples truncated)
```
Noting: extra punctuation/questioning tone increased.

maria: thanks — I'll open a revert PR for the promptpack builder flag (small change). PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/promptpacks/pull/4123 (revert strip_trailing_punct). I'll trigger the canary nightly with the revert commit and post results.

sam: Nice. For the canary, please run both `rwinf-2.1` and `rwinf-2.1-quant` so we catch quantization interactions.

maria: will do. ETA: canary run tonight, I’ll post the delta in the morning.

kevin: If canary passes, we promote revert and then decide if we want to bake punctuation-normalization into a later, controlled change with explicit evals.

alice: re: approvals — devon, are you ok with fast-tracking this revert as operational patch?

devon: yes go ahead. If canary fails, we regroup. Otherwise merge after 3 approvals and mergebot will handle rollout. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — tagging this thread `regression-triage` and closing after merge+green canary.

sam: thanks everyone. :heart:

maria: (followup) canary results posted: canary reduced the F1 delta to -0.01 vs baseline. Looks like the strip was the cause. Will merge revert this morning.

kevin: awesome, closing the loop. :tada:
